dedupe_keys.name: mangrove loss and growing coastal flood exposure in east malaysia a multi decadal analysis with sea level rise projections

description: The study authors publish a Python notebook for analysing mangrove loss and coastal flood exposure along Sabah and Sarawak in East Malaysia. Zenodo provides the notebook free under CC BY 4.0. It combines Global Mangrove Watch, Copernicus elevation, WorldPop, GADM boundaries and IPCC sea-level scenarios, comparing 1996–2020 land-cover change with projections to 2050. Inundation is screened at several elevation thresholds and linked to population exposure. The code can support green-infrastructure and coastal-adaptation scenario screening. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this workflow. Coverage is a ten-kilometre coastal buffer and selected input vintages. A limitation is that threshold screening is not a full hydrodynamic or defence-failure simulation, and the five upstream datasets are not contained in the notebook. Published exposure figures were not independently verified. No code was executed or data downloaded.
